description: Branches start with chore/renovate- to pass scripts/check-branch-name.sh. Renovate owns every branch with this prefix and may delete it or rename its pull request, so do not use it for other branches.
branchNameStrict turns dots, underscores, and other special characters after the prefix into hyphens.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Mondays 00:00-11:59 UTC (09:00-20:59 KST). Mend runs each repository about every 4 hours, so the window is wider than the preset's before 4am.

packageRules.description: The peer range is the oxlint support promised to users (#11), not a pinned tool version.
pnpm-workspace.yaml requires oxlint and @oxlint/plugins to move together.
Raise the floor of the published @oxlint/plugins range with oxlint, not only the lockfile.
pnpm locks the Node.js runtime from this range and Renovate reads no locked version for it, so only bump brings new Node.js releases.
Stay on the Node.js 24 LTS line; moving to a newer LTS is a deliberate change made by hand.
